hp_steward.text: Home Park, home of the Pilgrims. Argyle since 1886. Green shirts, green army, and a long, long way to every away game.
Nobody's quite sure where the Argyle comes from. A street, a regiment, a pub. It's been argued about for over a century, usually in the pub.

hp_kitman.text: We're called the Pilgrims after the Mayflower lot. Our badge has the ship on it. They sailed for a new life; we sail up the M5 for a draw.
Proper job, the pitch this year. Rolled it myself. Don't walk on it. You're walking on it.
